headline: Up to 350 suspected scam call centers are operating in Karachi, NCCIA Additional Director Shahzad Akbar said on Friday, after the agency raided a call center and arrested 273 people, Arab News reports.

card.desc: NCCIA ke mutabiq 300 se 350 mashkook call centers sargaram

caption:
Karachi mein 350 tak mashkook scam call centers!
Arab News ke mutabiq NCCIA ke Additional Director Shahzad Akbar ne Friday ko bataya ke survey mein Karachi mein 300 se 350 scam call centers ki nishandahi hui hai. NCCIA ne ek call center par raid kar ke 273 afraad ko giraftar kiya, jis par ghair mulki shehriyon se fraud ka ilzam hai.
Kya aap ko kabhi fraud call aayi hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
